feed.title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
feed.subtitle: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.
feed.rights: Catalog annotations: MIT. Linked resources keep their own terms.

entry.title: WildClawBench
entry.summary: WildClawBench evaluates agents on 60 tasks in a live tool environment that includes browser use, email, files and coding. It releases evaluation code and links to task data and trajectories.

entry.title: OpenAdapt Agent
entry.summary: OpenAdapt Agent exposes demonstrated application workflows as callable tools for AI agents. It enters values in an app and checks the record before and after saving.

entry.title: Rico Dataset
entry.summary: Rico Dataset is a collection of mobile app interaction and design data presented through Interaction Mining, with 70k screens and 10k user flows across 5k apps.

entry.title: Cerner PowerChart Browser Automation
entry.summary: A browser automation scaffold for Cerner PowerChart with actions for login, patient search, results, orders, and documentation export, plus a selector reference.

entry.title: Code2World
entry.summary: Code2World provides code for predicting the next Android GUI screen from a screenshot and proposed action through renderable code, with an AndroidWorld agent integration.

entry.title: MiniMax M3
entry.summary: MiniMax M3 is a multimodal model whose release page describes desktop operation from visual input and cross-application tasks through MiniMax Code.

entry.title: ToL Hierarchical GUI region detection
entry.summary: Code and configurations for training a hierarchical Android GUI region detector with DINO and running region inference on the ScreenPR benchmark.

entry.title: AI Agents for Computer Use
entry.summary: A browsable list of agents for desktop and mobile GUI control, with agent and dataset overviews linked from a companion survey repository.

entry.title: AppSim-UberEats
entry.summary: AppSim-UberEats is an Android app replica with interactive shopping screens, seeded data and scripts for checking task events and answers during mobile-agent evaluation.

entry.title: Browser Use Pi
entry.summary: Browser Use Pi is a TypeScript SDK for a browser agent that writes JavaScript to control Chrome through CDP and reads accessibility trees and screenshots for feedback.

entry.title: Claude Fable 5.1
entry.summary: Claude Fable 5.1 is a hosted model offering whose agent uses include operating a browser; its product page also discusses evaluation on OSWorld 2.0.

entry.title: HiconAgent
entry.summary: HiconAgent provides GUI-policy training code that samples histories of varied lengths and compresses past interactions during policy optimization.

entry.title: LlamaTouch Evaluator
entry.summary: LlamaTouch Evaluator checks mobile-agent execution traces against annotated interface states and provides exact-match and subsequence action baselines.

entry.title: OpenGVLab/MMBench-GUI
entry.summary: MMBench-GUI releases annotations and offline images for evaluating interface understanding and grounding within a GUI-agent benchmark spanning desktop, mobile and web platforms.

entry.title: SE-GUI
entry.summary: SE-GUI provides training and evaluation code for a GUI-grounding model refined with location-based rewards and attention feedback; its README links separate weights and seed data.

entry.title: SkillPacks
entry.summary: SkillPacks records and approves agent tool actions for retrieval and later training, illustrated with a desktop-control example.

entry.title: The OS X Accessibility Model
entry.summary: Apple's OS X guide explains how accessibility clients inspect an app's element hierarchy, read control properties, invoke actions and receive interface-change notifications.

entry.title: WAREX Supplementary Code
entry.summary: WAREX supplementary code uses mitmproxy add-ons to inject popups or server and network errors into web-agent tests and record token use and latency.

entry.title: Action-Type-Conditioned Grounding for GUI Agents
entry.summary: Research code for GUI grounding that predicts an action type and then conditions coordinate prediction on it. It compares six conditioning methods and includes training and evaluation scripts.

entry.title: AppSim-Eleme
entry.summary: An Android food-delivery app built as a local test environment for AI interaction. It supplies shopping workflows, predefined tasks, action logging and evaluation scripts.

entry.title: Auto-UI
entry.summary: A multimodal interface agent that uses earlier actions and future action plans to predict the next action. The repository provides training and inference instructions.

entry.title: Browser Harness JS
entry.summary: A JavaScript CLI and SDK that expose typed Chrome DevTools Protocol calls through a persistent browser session, allowing agents to inspect tabs and issue browser actions.

entry.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
entry.summary: A Claude release with an optional extended-thinking mode. Anthropic describes its mouse and keyboard computer-use capability and reports OSWorld evaluation results.

entry.title: Epic EHR Browser Automation
entry.summary: A browser automation scaffold for Epic EHR workflows such as appointments, patient lookup, notes and messaging. It documents authentication, sessions and example actions.

entry.title: Kirk Engine
entry.summary: An Android agent that uses screenshots and accessibility trees to choose taps, typing and swipes. Its page reports an AndroidWorld run and describes per-task verification artifacts.

entry.title: NeurIPS 2025: 45 Computer-Use Agent Papers You Should Know About
entry.summary: An annotated reading list of 45 NeurIPS 2025 computer-use agent papers, organized around benchmarks, safety, grounding and agent architectures.

entry.title: Steel Cookbook
entry.summary: A collection of Steel browser automation examples covering browser libraries, screenshot-driven computer-use models and agent frameworks in several programming languages.

entry.title: Tencent AI LAB - Self-Improving Agent
entry.summary: A research code collection for web-agent self-improvement, including WebEvolver's world-model approach and WebCoT's reconstructed reasoning trajectories.

entry.title: WorkArena-Instances
entry.summary: A restricted-access set of ServiceNow instances for running WorkArena benchmark evaluations. The repository provides instance information and states research-use conditions.

entry.title: WorldGUI-Bench
entry.summary: A desktop GUI evaluation dataset with user requests, instructional videos and pre-actions that vary task starting states. The release includes task metadata and a data archive.

entry.title: AgentQL
entry.summary: Web automation tool with a query language and Playwright-based Python and JavaScript SDKs for finding page elements, interacting with sites, and extracting data.

entry.title: ClawGUI-Eval
entry.summary: GUI grounding evaluation data for six benchmarks, with images, prompts, and prior outputs for an inference, judging, and metrics workflow.

entry.title: duvo-eye-1-evals
entry.summary: Dataset of per-sample GUI grounding predictions and reference points for public benchmarks, accompanied by a script for rescoring model outputs.

entry.title: Finalrun Agentic Approach
entry.summary: Illustrated account of FinalRun's Android agent approach, with task walkthroughs and recordings showing screen observation, action planning, and state checks.

entry.title: FluidGPT
entry.summary: Android agent product presented through recorded AndroidWorld runs. Fluiz reports completion of 116 tasks across 20 apps through screen interaction.

entry.title: FSB v0.9.92
entry.summary: Chrome extension for natural-language browser automation that accepts a user's request and browses on their behalf.

entry.title: openadapt-retrieval
entry.summary: Archived retrieval tool that indexes GUI demonstrations from task text and screenshots, then finds similar examples through a Python API or CLI.

entry.title: RecreationWorld
entry.summary: Framework for hybrid computer-use agents that inspect running reference apps, implement replicas with coding tools, and verify behavior across five platforms.

entry.title: OpenAdapt Desktop
entry.summary: OpenAdapt Desktop records work in web and desktop apps, compiles recordings into local programs, and replays data-entry tasks with screen checks and human approval.

entry.title: Amazon Nova Act Samples
entry.summary: Code examples and reference applications show how to build browser workflows with Amazon Nova Act and deploy the SDK on AWS compute services.

entry.title: Amap-Sim
entry.summary: An offline Android map-app simulation for AI automation tests, with map browsing, place search, routing, and navigation backed by locally prepared data.

entry.title: chromedp examples
entry.summary: A collection of 46 Go examples showing how to control Chrome with chromedp, including page interaction, screenshots, tabs, and protocol operations.

entry.title: HIPPO Agent
entry.summary: A computer-use agent for multistep GUI tasks that stores task facts and progress in working memory and combines planning, grounding, and completion checks.

entry.title: K²-Agent
entry.summary: A hierarchical mobile-device agent that combines a demonstration-informed planner with a learned action executor; the release includes AndroidWorld evaluation trajectories.

entry.title: openadapt-capture
entry.summary: A desktop recorder for GUI demonstrations that pairs mouse and keyboard actions with screen frames and stores sessions for later inspection in Python.

entry.title: Playwright Test for VS Code
entry.summary: A VS Code extension for Playwright browser testing that records page actions into tests and provides test running, locator inspection, debugging, and trace viewing.

entry.title: Procore Browser Automation
entry.summary: A Procore browser automation scaffold with actions for construction RFIs, submittal tracking, daily logs, and project-report export.

entry.title: SAP Concur Browser Automation
entry.summary: A SAP Concur browser automation scaffold with actions for expense reports, receipt uploads, approval queues, and spend-data export.

entry.title: SAP Fiori Browser Automation
entry.summary: A SAP Fiori browser automation scaffold with documented actions for purchase orders, approvals, financial-data export, and invoice handling.

entry.title: ServiceNow Browser Automation
entry.summary: A ServiceNow browser automation scaffold with documented actions for incidents, CMDB records, task assignment, and report export.

entry.title: Veeva Vault Browser Automation
entry.summary: A Veeva Vault browser automation scaffold with documented actions for uploading documents, routing reviews, approving records, and exporting audit trails.

entry.title: Anchor
entry.summary: Anchor provides cloud browser environments for AI agents to navigate authenticated websites and run browser workloads, with SDK and MCP integration.

entry.title: bb-browser
entry.summary: A CLI and MCP tool that lets AI agents operate an existing Chrome session through page snapshots, element actions, screenshots, and website-specific adapters.

entry.title: camofox-browser
entry.summary: A browser server for AI agents that exposes accessibility snapshots and referenced page actions through a REST API, with isolated sessions and authenticated browsing support.

entry.title: Oracle PeopleSoft Browser Automation
entry.summary: A browser automation scaffold for Oracle PeopleSoft that defines actions for queries, leave requests, employee records, and payroll workflows through Puppeteer or Anchor Browser.

entry.title: Veeva CRM (Veeva Commercial Cloud) Browser Automation
entry.summary: A browser automation scaffold for Veeva CRM that defines actions for call reports, sample inventory, account records, and territory data through Puppeteer or Anchor Browser.

entry.title: Workday HCM Browser Automation
entry.summary: A browser automation scaffold for Workday HCM that uses Puppeteer or Anchor Browser to run HR and payroll workflows through the application interface.

entry.title: Anchor Browser
entry.summary: Anchor Browser provides cloud browser sessions for agents through SDK, CDP and REST interfaces. Its documentation describes natural-language tasks, authentication and reusable workflows.

entry.title: Midscene iOS
entry.summary: Midscene iOS provides an SDK and playground for automating an iOS device through screen actions and queries. It uses macOS device mirroring and exposes a browser-based playground.

entry.title: Mind2Web-Live
entry.summary: A SeeAct-V web agent implementation for Mind2Web-Live. It uses screen images to plan actions and a visual grounding model to locate targets for coordinate-based actions.

entry.title: openadapt-privacy
entry.summary: openadapt-privacy removes personal and health information from GUI recordings, including text, event data, accessibility trees and screenshots. The repository is archived.

entry.title: Oracle E-Business Suite Browser Automation
entry.summary: A browser automation scaffold for Oracle E-Business Suite workflows. It describes Puppeteer and cloud browser options for login, requisitions, approvals and requests.

entry.title: Salesforce Classic Browser Automation
entry.summary: A browser automation scaffold for Salesforce Classic. It describes actions for login, lead creation, opportunity updates, report export and record updates.

entry.title: WebGen-Bench
entry.summary: WebGen-Bench evaluates generated websites with automated tests, including a UI agent that carries out interactions and checks outcomes. The repository supplies evaluation code and data.

entry.title: GUI-Rise
entry.summary: A GUI navigation agent that combines stepwise reasoning with history summarization; its repository provides supervised training, reinforcement learning, and evaluation instructions.

entry.title: Lightpanda Browser
entry.summary: A headless browser for AI agents and automation, with released Linux and macOS binaries and interfaces for browser control and scripted tasks.

entry.title: Moli
entry.summary: A headless browser for AI agents that extracts web content and runs browser tasks through CLI, CDP, and WebDriver interfaces, with rendering performed on demand.

entry.title: openadapt-ml
entry.summary: A Python research package for GUI-action models, with trajectory schemas, model adapters, fine-tuning, grounding, and a policy interface for predicting the next action.

entry.title: OpenAPA
entry.summary: A computer-use agent for desktop GUI tasks that combines screenshot-based reasoning, visual grounding, planning, and action execution across applications.

entry.title: The TinyFish Cookbook
entry.summary: A collection of sample applications and recipes for TinyFish web agents, covering page retrieval, structured search, and multi-step browser automation.

entry.title: WebOperator
entry.summary: A web agent using action-aware tree search to explore tasks and backtrack, checking page reconstruction and accounting for actions that may change website state.

entry.title: Avenir-UX
entry.summary: Avenir-UX runs web tasks and scores interface usability after agent actions. It combines step assessments with persona settings and produces session reports.

entry.title: GUI-Shift
entry.summary: GUI-Shift is a training framework that uses pairs of GUI screenshots to teach vision-language models to predict the action behind an interface transition.

entry.title: Midscene Python
entry.summary: Midscene Python is a framework for natural-language automation of websites and Android devices, with model-assisted actions, element location, extraction and assertions.

entry.title: noVNC
entry.summary: noVNC is a browser-based VNC client and JavaScript library for viewing and controlling remote desktops through mouse, keyboard, clipboard and touch input.

entry.title: ScreenAgent Web Client
entry.summary: ScreenAgent Web Client connects language models to remote desktops through a browser and VNC, representing mouse and keyboard actions as structured calls.

entry.title: vePhone
entry.summary: vePhone supplies remotely controlled cloud phones and example integrations for mobile and computer-use agents, including task execution and result retrieval.

entry.title: AgentEnv
entry.summary: AgentEnv connects agent models to Android devices or emulators, translating actions and returning screenshots and view hierarchies while recording interactions.

entry.title: Midscene PC Docker
entry.summary: Midscene PC Docker packages an Ubuntu GNOME desktop with Chrome and a Midscene PC automation service, exposing the graphical environment through VNC.

entry.title: Puppeteer
entry.summary: Puppeteer is a JavaScript browser-control library for Chrome and Firefox. Its API supports scripted page navigation and interaction.

entry.title: WMA Web Agent
entry.summary: A web agent uses a learned world model to predict consequential page changes before choosing an action. The repository includes trajectory processing and inference code.

entry.title: CollabUIAgents
entry.summary: CollabUIAgents trains UI agents with synthesized interaction data and process rewards assigned by collaborating agents. The repository releases data collection and inference code.

entry.title: CrashTranslator
entry.summary: CrashTranslator generates Android app interactions to reproduce crashes from stack traces. The repository provides code, data and setup instructions for emulator-based runs.

entry.title: Midscene Examples
entry.summary: Midscene Examples provides runnable AI automation and testing cases for web, Android, iOS and desktop interfaces, including YAML workflows and SDK integrations.

entry.title: WeChat Mac RPA
entry.summary: WeChat Mac RPA is a macOS agent that reads WeChat screenshots, reasons over conversations and uses system automation to send messages and switch chats.

entry.title: Awesome Computer Use
entry.summary: A curated reading list of computer GUI use research and software, linking to agent demos, frameworks, and papers across desktop and web interfaces.

entry.title: bdg - Browser Debugger CLI
entry.summary: A browser CLI for agents to navigate and interact with pages while inspecting the DOM, network requests, console output, and layout through individual commands.

entry.title: finalrun-agent
entry.summary: An AI-driven CLI for testing Android and iOS apps from YAML instructions. It observes the screen, performs touch and text actions, and reports results with video and logs.

entry.title: Jedi-7B-1080p
entry.summary: A released model checkpoint for computer-use grounding research, based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. The repository includes weight shards and tokenizer files.

entry.title: MedSPOT
entry.summary: A sequential GUI grounding benchmark covering 10 medical imaging applications. It evaluates target localization across multi-step workflows and provides model evaluation scripts.

entry.title: MMSearch-Plus
entry.summary: A benchmark of 311 visual reasoning tasks for multimodal browsing agents, requiring iterative image and text retrieval. The repository links the dataset and provides a loading helper.

entry.title: Agentic Web
entry.summary: A research reading list on agents and the web, organized around development, retrieval, planning, safety and benchmarks.

entry.title: gui-agent
entry.summary: Research code for GUI-agent experiments, accompanied by a trained interface element detector, experiment configurations and prompts.

entry.title: SeeAct Web Agent (Chrome Extension)
entry.summary: A Chrome extension that runs a SeeAct-based agent in an existing browser session to navigate websites, gather information and prepare forms.

entry.title: AgentGym
entry.summary: AgentGym provides interactive environments for developing and evaluating agents, including web tasks in WebShop and WebArena, with trajectory collection and training support.

entry.title: ConClick
entry.summary: ConClick is a GUI grounding model trained with coordinate supervision and target distractor ranking. Its ReClick inference method revisits candidate screen regions before choosing a click.

entry.title: Screen Point-and-Read Data
entry.summary: Screen Point-and-Read Data pairs OS, web and mobile screenshots with selected points, annotated regions and corrected captions for layout-aware GUI interpretation.

entry.title: AdbGPT
entry.summary: An Android bug replay agent that extracts action details from written bug reports and uses the current app screen to guide reproduction steps.

entry.title: API-Based-Agent
entry.summary: Code for web agents that use application APIs and browser actions together, with scripts for evaluating the hybrid approach on WebArena.

entry.title: Awesome Reinforcement Learning for GUI Agents
entry.summary: A curated reading list of reinforcement learning work on GUI agents, organized by learning methods, reward and efficiency questions, datasets, and training environments.
